messages:
Ana (Docs): Heads-up: I'm starting a small sweep to align terminology and tone across the SDK pages + quickstarts. Main items: pick a canonical term for the concept we called both 'model variant' and 'variant' in older copy, standardize on active-voice quickstart bullets, and fix a couple of broken internal links I found.

Jared (SDK): Good call. For the term I'd prefer 'model variant' (two words) — it's explicit and maps well to our runtime API naming. If we standardize, I'll update SDK snippets and alias fields where necessary.

Rina (Platform): +1 to 'model variant'. Platform logs and routing use that compound too. We should add a single line in the glossary and then run a bulk replace for the docs repo.

Sam (Eng): FYI runtime uses 'variant' in some code comments; it's low risk but we should avoid changing code comments. Docs-only replacements only. Will add a note in the PR.

Ana (Docs): Plan: 1) add glossary entry: 'model variant — a specific trained instance or configuration of a model used for inference' 2) update quickstarts to use imperative tone e.g., 'Install the SDK', 'Call client.generate' 3) fix links found in embeddings and streaming pages. I'll open a PR with the changes + a small script to run grep/sed for docs-only files.

Nina (Localization): Please put the glossary entry in canonical English first and flag it for localization. Keep sentences short — we should avoid parentheses inside the one-line definition.

Jared (SDK): For the SDK snippet changes, quick question: do you want the code examples to show the newer `model_variant` param name or keep `variant`? We need to maintain snippet parity across languages.

Ana (Docs): Use `model_variant` in examples. Add a parenthetical note only in the migration section: 'legacy: `variant`'. Keep the in-line examples concise.

docs-bot: Link checker queued for PR #1302  2 pages flagged (embeddings.md, streaming.md).

Sam (Eng): I'll help review the grep/sed script to ensure we don't accidentally touch autogenerated files under /site/api/ or the sdk code samples directory. Docs-only path: docs/ and content/.

Rina (Platform): After merge, Platform will watch analytics for any spike in 404s from changed anchors. If any pop up, we'll add redirects.

Ana (Docs): Drafting the PR now. I'll include: glossary entry, quickstart tone edits, the migration note for `variant` -> `model_variant`, link fixes, and the grep/sed script with safeguards. Targeting merge by EOD tomorrow.

Jared (SDK): I'll add matching snippets in python/js/go once PR is open.

Nina (Localization): Ping us when merged and please add the i18n flag on the glossary file.

Ana (Docs): Will do. Thanks everyone.

docs-bot: PR #1302 opened by Ana (Docs) — running link check and docs linter.
